elena (People Ops): Heads-up: open enrollment window shortened this year to 10 business days (starts Mon). Please read details below — important deadlines + travel conduct reminder. :spiral_calendar:
tom (Benefits): Why the change? We're aligning benefits deadlines with new payroll cutoffs and reducing mid-cycle changes that complicate payroll runs. Shorter window, same options.
jas (eng): Shorter window sounds tight. What are the exact dates?
elena (People Ops): Window: Mon 1745300000 -> Fri 1745300099 (10 business days). Elections must be submitted by 11:59pm PT on the final day. We will NOT accept changes after cutoff except qualifying life events.
tom (Benefits): Quick checklist: 1) Review current elections at https://benefits.redwood/portal 2) Use the "Compare Plans" tool 3) Submit elections and save confirmation PDF. If you don't enroll, current coverage will continue in most cases but FSAs require active re-enrollment.
hr-bot: New: Auto-reminder schedule enabled. You will receive 3 reminders (start, mid-window, 48hrs left) and a final confirmation DM when your submission is processed.
jas (eng): Any change to PTO or carryover rules tied to enrollment?
elena (People Ops): No change to PTO policy in this announcement. However, small clarification: rollover cap for unused wellness days increases from 3 -> 5 for this plan year only; auto-applied for eligible employees. Details on intranet.
tom (Benefits): Travel & vendor conduct reminder: if you book supplier/vendor services while on company travel, vendor interactions are subject to Redwood's code of conduct. Report concerns to security@redwood.com. See short FAQs at https://intranet.redwood/travel-conduct.
jas (eng): What about reimbursements for vendors flagged in the conduct list?
tom (Benefits): Reimbursements will be reviewed case-by-case. If a vendor is under active investigation, finance may place a temporary hold. We'll notify affected employees and provide alternatives.
elena (People Ops): Need help? Drop into the Open Enrollment office hours: Wed 10-2 PT & Fri 1-4 PT (Zoom link on benefits portal) or email benefits@redwood.com. For urgent payroll questions, CC payroll@redwood.com.
jas (eng): Thanks, will watch for reminders.
elena (People Ops): Thanks all 64f — please complete elections early to avoid last-minute issues.
